responsibility: Implements the -Wrestrict warning pass and the reusable overlap/bounds checking engine for built-in memory and string functions. It models source and destination accesses with builtin_memref and builtin_access descriptors, computes object bases, offset and size ranges using pointer-query and range-query information, checks for out-of-bounds accesses and overlapping copies under function-specific rules, and emits or suppresses the appropriate diagnostics for restrict, array-bounds, and related raw/string memory operations.
same_name_distinction: Implements both the -Wrestrict GIMPLE pass and the underlying bounds/overlap analysis routines that gcc/gimple-ssa-warn-restrict.h merely declares for reuse. Unlike the header, this file defines the pass class, call walker, builtin_memref/builtin_access modeling, diagnostics, and check_bounds_or_overlap behavior.
